snippet.title: One More Flight –  Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
A doomed flight. A repeating disaster. Only your knowledge survives.

One More Flight is a pixel-art psychological horror game set aboard a doomed flight. Explore the aircraft, uncover its secrets, and use what you learn to break the cycle.

Wishlist One More Flight on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4529770/One_More_Flight/

Play the demo during Steam Next Fest, October 19–26.

#OneMoreFlight #IndieHorror #PixelArtGame #SteamNextFest
